data.description:
English:story: Dizzy has suffered a lot since she was alive...

The details about Dizzy's birth are unclear, only that her mother is Justice, the queen of the Gears and the cause of a world war between humans and gears, and that Dizzy was born in 2177 while Justice was sealed inside her dimensional prison.

Dizzy's birth was supposed to be in 2017, since Justice being a part of Aria, Frederick's partner now better known as Sol Bad Guy, had become pregnant with him, but due to all the past events this girl was born in 2177 being a Gear.

Dizzy was found by an elderly childless couple when she was still a baby who decided to raise her. She spent six months with them, but the other villagers were scared due to Dizzy's accelerated growth, and even more so after she grew wings and a tail. When it became clear that she was at least part Gear, the village believed her to be a "monster" and tried to get rid of her.

To protect her, the pair hid Dizzy in the Demon Forest. At first they would visit her, but slowly grew distant and never returned, and Dizzy grew accustomed to living alone. One day, she befriended Josephine, a blind girl who thought Dizzy was an angel. Dizzy let her visit as much as she wanted, but told her not to bring strangers.

Sometime in 2181, Josephine brought Testament who called himself "Kliff" into the forest while they were fleeing from someone who wanted to kidnap her, who wanted to kidnap Josephine to lure Faust. After Josephine got hurt, Dizzy and Kliff took her to Faust's clinic, and Kliff revealed to Dizzy his true name, Testament, and that they (he) were also a Gear. Faust successfully treated Josephine and eventually cured her blindness, but noticed Dizzy's tail and the color of her wings. Aware of Dizzy's return, the villagers burned down Faust's clinic in an attempt to kill her. However, Dizzy, having a big heart, did not want to end the lives of the villagers. Dizzy was so desperate that her wings apparently became alive. Necro, which was the part of Dizzy that showed she was a Gear, killed all the villagers who dared to attack her. Undine, the kind and 'human' part of Dizzy, was in charge of protecting Dizzy, covering her eyes so she would not see all the blood she shed thanks to Necro. Both wings retaliated despite Dizzy's pleas. Testament swore to protect Dizzy and subdued her. No one was seriously hurt, but Josephine slapped Dizzy, calling her a demon, and then told her to return to the forest. Saddened, Dizzy left accompanied by Testament before being able to see Josephine's change of attitude thanks to Faust's words.

Around October, the world learns of Dizzy's existence, and being the daughter of the Queen of the Gears, the government tries to hunt her down even though Dizzy did not have the same intentions as her mother, being a Gear that broke free from Justice's control. Because of this, there is now a bounty of W$ 500,000 for Dizzy's death.

Dizzy is currently harassed by many bounty hunters and even though she and Testament drive many of them out of the forest, Dizzy can no longer bear to deal with this and much less end the lives of the bounty hunters who come to kill her. Will she ever be able to escape this fate?

Abilities of a Gear: These include: superhuman strength, extended lifespan, rapid healing, etc.

Power Over Gears: She has inherited from Justice the ability to command other Gears or semi-Gears, but she doesn't like doing that

Gamma Beam: She fires a massive beam of gamma radiation, but her version is no match for Justice's, perhaps due to her Venebola personality.

Minor Shapeshifting: Dizzy possesses shapeshifting abilities, and her form is said to be able to transform into anything: from changing outfits at will, to transforming her sleeves or tail into monstrous mouths, extending her nails into claws, and transforming into a winged demon.

Necro and Undine: Most uniquely as a half-Gear, her Gear instincts have manifested in her wings, and act as a sort of autonomous defense mechanism. Necro and Undine can act separately from Dizzy herself; however, they generally only attack if Dizzy is in danger. If Dizzy falls unconscious, they can take over his body to fight in his place. They seem to specialize in one attribute of magic each: Fire for Necro's attacks and Water (in the form of ice) for Undine's.
